style: Newspaper comic-strip cartoon: simple bold rounded black outlines, flat cheerful colours, minimal background, lots of plain white space, clean and readable like a classic daily gag strip.
suffix: Clean artwork only: no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no speech balloons, no captions, no sound-effect lettering, no signature, no logo, no panel border, no frame; the picture runs to the edges of the image.

items.prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain pure white background, full-body figures standing side by side in a neutral pose, front three-quarter view, evenly spaced with wide white gaps between them so each can be cut out separately, no shadows on the ground, no background scenery. Left: Pip, a small round penguin with a red-and-white striped knitted scarf, little orange beak and feet, big bright eyes. Right: Otto, a big gentle walrus, brown and round, long white tusks, bushy whisker moustache, a small blue bow tie, a tall white baker's hat, kind sleepy eyes. Pip only reaches up to Otto's belly.

Draw a NEW comic panel in exactly the drawing style of the reference images. The references are design sheets only: reference image 1 shows Pip, the small penguin with a red-and-white striped scarf; reference image 2 shows Otto, the big walrus with a blue bow tie and a baker's hat. Keep each character's face, hair, clothes, colours and proportions identical to the reference, but give them the new pose and expression described; do not copy the white background or the poses of the references. Inside a tiny bakery with a little wooden counter and shelves of bread loaves: Pip the penguin walks in through the door, waving cheerfully; Otto the walrus stands behind the counter, smiling. Keep the top third quiet and uncluttered (plain pale wall) so speech balloons can be lettered there later. The only characters in the picture are Pip and Otto; no other people or animals.
